verdict.rationale: There is no explicit policy or opt-out against training on customer data. Indirect control comes from the open-source library that runs in your own app [orama-docs-12], on-premise deployment of Orama Cloud on your own infrastructure [orama-docs-8], and Cloud embeddings generated with local models [orama-docs-45]. These keep data within your control, but some flows (AnswerSession) proxy queries to the OpenAI API [orama-docs-18]. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training data-use policy or contractual commitment, a documented opt-out control, terms covering third-party LLM providers, and independent corroboration.
